content.text: That fixed it. I'll complete the remaining work orders.

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H2","instruction_en":"Do not build yet. Tape an A4 sheet upright on the lower door frame next to the threshold and take a new photo, and measure the threshold height by hand.","instruction_zh":"先不要施工。請在門檻旁的下門框直立貼上一張A4紙後重新拍照，並用尺手量門檻高度。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H3","instruction_en":"Secure the edge of the red rug against the wall in the walkthrough, or remove the rug from the area.","instruction_zh":"請將走道牆邊紅色地毯的邊緣固定貼平，或將地毯移走收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H4","instruction_en":"Move the black cable off the walkway and doorway threshold in the walkthrough and place it along the wall.","instruction_zh":"請將走道門檻上的黑色電線移離走道，沿牆邊整理收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H5","instruction_en":"Pick up the cable with plug from the hallway tiled floor and store it away from the walkway.","instruction_zh":"請將走廊磁磚地上的插頭電線拿起收好，離開走道。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H6","instruction_en":"Pick up the white sneakers from the tiled floor in the walkthrough and place them in a shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將走道磁磚地上的白色布鞋拿起，放到鞋櫃裡。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H7","instruction_en":"Pick up the light-colored shoes from the wood floor in the walkthrough and place them in a shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將走道木地板上的淺色鞋子拿起，放到鞋櫃裡。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H8","instruction_en":"Pick up the dark blue slippers from the tiled floor in the walkthrough and place them in a shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將走道磁磚地上的深藍色拖鞋拿起，放到鞋櫃裡。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H9","instruction_en":"Pick up the dark blue slide slippers from the tiled floor in the walkthrough and place them in a shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"請將走道磁磚地上的深藍色拖鞋拿起，放到鞋櫃裡。"}
